benchmark: Severity Lab HSV Lesion Quantification vs Reference
assessment: Krishi Netra's HSV morphological lesion segmentation achieved an R² of 0.811 against ground-truth lesion annotations, which falls well within the benchmark range reported by Cornell University's Leaf Doctor (0.79 to 0.96). This confirms that the severity engine provides reliable, quantitative lesion proportion metrics rather than ungrounded estimates.
